run_dockerjob_kill_container: run docker_kill to stop a running Docker container by its container ID
run_dockerjob_get_mapped_port: run docker_mapped_port to retrieve the host port mapped to a container's internal port
run_dockerjob_get_ip_address: run docker_ip_address to retrieve the IP address of a running Docker container
run_dockerjob_wait_for_healthy: run wait_for_healthy to poll a container until it passes its Docker health check
run_dockerjob_DockerJob_class: run DockerJob to encapsulate a Docker container as a job with kill, port mapping, and health check methods
